newsitem.title: RUSSIA: WEATHER - Conditions at CIS airports - October 31.
newsitem.headline: WEATHER - Conditions at CIS airports - October 31.

text.p: Strong winds and rain may force the closure of the airport in the Russian Baltic enclave of Kaliningrad to close on November 4 and 5, the State Weather Service said on Friday.
It said the probability of closure was 70 percent.
Strong winds and wet snow may close airports in Murmansk and St Petersburg in coming days, it said.
Flights may be postponed at airports of Riga and Vilnius on November 4 and 5 due to strong winds and rain, the service said.
